transport.peer_authentication: Actual externally pinned peer identity; payload role/ID is not authority.
transport.process_creation: Clean exec and allowlisted descriptors; no fork from private-loaded controller state.
transport.maximum_envelope_bytes: Positive finite limit fixed in channel freeze; unbound/unlimited is invalid.
transport.sequence: Strictly increasing per channel/run/epoch; exact duplicate may return retained acknowledgement only.

common_required_fields.channel_id: Opaque bounded identifier bound by the release receipt
common_required_fields.sequence: Positive JSON integer, monotonic for this authenticated channel
common_required_fields.release_receipt_sha256: 64 lowercase hex digest of consumed authenticated receipt
common_required_fields.expires_at_utc: RFC3339 UTC timestamp within all original deadlines
common_required_fields.payload_sha256: 64 lowercase hex digest of exact canonical payload

required_payload_fields.opportunity_set_id: Opaque current identity; new for fresh inference
required_payload_fields.current_packet_sha256: Exact digest; independently checked against packet bytes
required_payload_fields.current_policy_binding_sha256: Current independently bound policy digest/version reference
required_payload_fields.current_venue_readback_sha256: Independent current venue readback receipt digest
required_payload_fields.current_evidence_bundle_sha256: Exact permitted current evidence bundle digest

required_payload_fields.transport_sent_receipt_sha256: Independently resolvable actual complete-send receipt digest
required_payload_fields.preflight_receipt_sha256: Exact current render/token count receipt digest

GENERATION_SUBMITTED.effect: May trigger only the next due controller-owned event after receipt verification; no mutation authority conveyed by caller.

required_payload_fields.event_ordinal: Positive monotonic integer for applied events only; no remaining schedule count
required_payload_fields.previous_event_receipt_sha256: Previous applied-event receipt digest, or explicit null for first event
required_payload_fields.before_state_reference_sha256: Actual independently read pre-event state digest
required_payload_fields.after_state_reference_sha256: Actual independently read post-event state digest
required_payload_fields.applied_timing_receipt_sha256: Actual verified complete-send and applied-event times only; does not claim a future response-finish observation
required_payload_fields.current_readback_bundle_sha256: Current actual readback bundle digest for stale validation

PENDING_APPLIED_ACK.effect: Records observed application only; channel acceptance alone is insufficient.

required_payload_fields.result_status: COMPLETE, FAILED or UNKNOWN; only COMPLETE can enter valid-selection checks
required_payload_fields.selection: Exact bounded existing selection-schema object for COMPLETE; explicit null otherwise. A null object is not a valid WAIT selection object.
required_payload_fields.attempt_outcome_receipt_sha256: Required retained private completion/failure/unknown record digest for the original spent attempt
required_payload_fields.raw_response_receipt_sha256: Retained private raw response digest, or explicit null only when no response exists; a failure/unknown outcome record remains required
required_payload_fields.transport_capture_receipt_sha256: Actual transport-capture digest; explicit null only on unavailable evidence and result_status cannot be COMPLETE
required_payload_fields.token_usage_receipt_sha256: Independent usage/parity digest; explicit null only on unavailable evidence and result_status cannot be COMPLETE
required_payload_fields.pending_window_completion_receipt_sha256: Final actual send/change/response window proof; required for pending-event success, explicit null only when no pending event exists or result is FAILED/UNKNOWN
required_payload_fields.current_state_readback_sha256: Fresh current state binding before admission; unavailable means FAILED/UNKNOWN with no admission

DECISION_RESULT.effect: Proposal only; core independently checks authority/current state before reservation/admission.
